blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — There is a law that requires public officials to declare in their Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALNs) the foreign currency funds converted to local values. Senate Impeachment Court Presiding Officer Francis Escudero made this statement on Tuesday during the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte when this matter was raised. Senator-judge Vicente Sotto III asked the prosecution’s witness, Office of the Ombudsman Central Records Division officer-in-charge Karen Batu, whether foreign currency funds should be stated as assets in SALNs.
